chunks.rationale: test/sidebar.test.tsx describe 'Sidebar snooze nested submenu (#583)'. New ArrowDown/Up/Home/End cases sit after the existing drill-in and typeahead tests. They use pressFocused, not press(el). Identity checks are assert.ok(active === item) — assert.equal on two DOM nodes hangs the suite while dumping circular fibers, same trap as assert.equal(node, null).
risks: Wrap tests assume last→first and first→last. A later clamp-instead-of-wrap change would fail them on purpose.
The disabled-Settle case uses status:'working'. If settle ever becomes clickable while a run is active, the skip test's precondition assert.equal(settle.disabled, true) fails first.

chunks.rationale: ThreadCard menu onKeyDown in src/components/Sidebar.tsx. ArrowDown/Up/Home/End are handled AFTER ArrowRight (open) and ArrowLeft/Backspace (back), so Snooze+ArrowDown cannot drill in. Escape is still useEscapeClose, not a back key. #582 stacking is untouched: data-menu-open on the card, .group:has([data-snooze-menu]) z-index 8.
risks: ArrowDown preventDefault stops the sidebar list from scrolling while the menu is focused. If a future overlay steals those keys, this handler must stay first.

enabledMenuItems queries the whole [data-snooze-menu]. That is correct only because the first-level items unmount while nested (back + presets are the only menuitems then). Re-introducing a flyout that keeps both levels in the DOM would mix panels.

chunks.rationale: focusMenuItem / focusMenuEdge reuse enabledMenuItems (same :not([disabled]) set as typeahead). Wrap with (from+delta+len)%len. Home/End jump to the ends of the current panel, including ‹ Snooze as first nested item. Click contract and data-snooze-preset / data-snooze-clear hooks are unchanged.
risks: This is Arrow-key focus movement, not a tabindex=-1 roving set. Tab still walks every native button in the menu.
Opening the … menu does not auto-focus the first menuitem. Arrow keys do nothing until focus is already inside the menu.
data-snooze-preset / data-snooze-clear and #582 stacking were not edited this turn.
This branch still carries the #583 drill-in markup plus the prior drill-in keyboard. Reviewers landing stacked PRs will conflict on Sidebar.tsx.
